title: Apparatus and method for performing at least one geometric dimension of an object

features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
features.note: The reference describes gripping elements but does not mention a housing with a hollow grip portion.

features.item: An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
features.note: The reference does not mention a vacuum generating device.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet
features.note: The reference does not mention a vacuum generating device or exhaust air being guided through a grip portion.

features.item: A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion
features.note: The reference does not mention any sound-damping devices.

features.item: A suction plate comprising a carrier plate and a seal fastened to the carrier plate extending around it
features.note: The reference does not describe a suction plate or a seal.

features.item: A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device in grip
features.note: The reference does not describe a grip unit with these specific components and functions.

features.item: Vacuum handling apparatus with suction plate and grip unit combined
features.note: The reference describes a device for measuring geometric dimensions, not a vacuum handling apparatus.

features.item: Grip portion at least partially lined with sound-damping material
features.note: The reference does not mention a grip portion or sound-damping material.

features.item: Vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion
features.note: The reference does not mention a vacuum generating device or housing portions.

features.note: The reference does not describe an elongated grip portion or housing portions with air outlets.

features.note: The reference does not mention an air collection screw, grip portion, or exhaust air.

features.item: Bent or curved air baffles downstream of grip portion directing exhaust air to air outlet
features.note: The reference does not mention air baffles, grip portions, or exhaust air.

features.item: Battery coupling point on second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from battery coupling point
features.note: The reference does not mention battery coupling points, air baffles, or exhaust air.

features.item: Grip unit and suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device
features.note: The reference does not describe a grip unit, suction plate, or a coupling device between them.

features.note: The reference does not describe a grip unit, suction opening, suction chamber, or suction plate.

claims.note: This reference describes a device for measuring geometric dimensions of an object, not a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device.
This reference describes a gripping means for moving an object for measurement, not a housing with a grip portion and an electrically operated vacuum generating device for a laying device.
The reference does not describe a grip portion designed as a hollow body.
The reference does not mention exhaust air being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet, nor a sound-damping device.
The reference describes an apparatus for measuring geometric dimensions of an object, not a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device with a sound-damping device in the grip portion.
The reference does not describe a grip portion lined with sound-damping material.
The reference describes a measurement device, not a grip unit with a vacuum generating device arranged in a housing portion.
The reference does not describe a sound-reducing device or lining in a housing portion.
This reference describes a device for measuring geometric dimensions of an object, not a grip unit with housing portions and air outlets.
This reference describes a device for measuring geometric dimensions of an object, not a grip unit with an air collection device or air collection screw.
This reference describes a device for measuring geometric dimensions of an object, not a grip unit with air baffles for guiding exhaust air.
This reference describes a device for measuring geometric dimensions of an object, not a grip unit with a battery coupling point or air baffles for directing exhaust air.
This reference does not discuss air baffles, exhaust air, or battery coupling points.
This reference describes an apparatus for measuring geometric dimensions of an object, not a vacuum handling apparatus.
This reference does not mention a suction plate, carrier plate, or a seal fastened to a carrier plate.
This reference does not describe a grip unit as defined in claim 1 of the subject invention.
This reference describes a gripping means for moving an object for measurement, but it does not disclose a grip unit and a suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device.

This reference describes a gripping means, which can include a retention system with suckers or pneumatic vacuum, but it does not explicitly disclose a grip unit with a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber delimited by a suction plate to generate a vacuum.

overall.why: The reference describes a method and device for measuring geometric dimensions of an object using gripping means and optical means, which is a different technical problem and solution than the subject invention's focus on vacuum handling apparatus with specific grip and sound-damping features.
